headlines.title: Trump faces backlash over role in Nvidia CEO’s reinstatement
headlines.description: President Trump is facing bipartisan backlash over his role in Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s reinstatement. Huang resigned less than two weeks ago after admitting to an affair with an alleged Chinese spy.

headlines.title: Congress reacts with anger and skepticism about Jensen Huang reinstatement
headlines.description: Lawmakers on both sides of the aisle vowed to press ahead with investigations into the once-again Nvidia CEO, who’s scheduled to meet with them next week.

headlines.title: How Will Severe Storm Impact Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade?
headlines.description: A massive storm system is racing up the East Coast and is expected to cause travel delays while also threatening to put a damper on the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade, possibly grounding the balloons. NBC’s Emilie Ikeda reports and TODAY’s Al Roker tracks the forecast.

headlines.title: Army: Controlled detonation of lead in Iowa is 'preferable for public health and safety'
headlines.description: Acting Army Secretary Adam R. Telle held a press conference in Iowa to discuss plans for the controlled detonation of toxic materials. He stressed that a "controlled, mitigated detonation" is "preferable for public health and safety."

headlines.title: Two arrested over suspected burglary at Prince William and Princess Kate's Norfolk estate
headlines.description: British police arrest two men in connection with a suspected burglary at Sandringham, the estate of Prince William and Princess Kate. NBC News’ Keir Simmons reports on the latest developments in the investigation and what authorities are saying about the incident.

headlines.title: Too young to be vaccinated for measles? Babies face growing threats from outbreaks
headlines.description: As measles outbreaks continue to soar, a new question has emerged: Should doctors give measles shots earlier to better protect babies?

headlines.title: A federal judge unseals court documents in connection with the search of Rep. Ilhan Omar's home
headlines.description: A federal judge unsealed more than 160 pages worth of court documents related to the search of Rep. Ilhan Omar's home. NBC News' Julie Tsirkin breaks down the latest details in this ongoing probe.

headlines.title: Meet the ‘GTA’ superfans who turned the game’s release into a major life event
headlines.description: From transforming their homes into “Grand Theft Auto”-inspired playgrounds to clearing their calendars at all costs, die-hard fans of the franchise pulled out all the stops for the arrival of “GTA VI.”

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.

headlines.title: Army to detonate lead explosives in Iowa on Wednesday morning as officials insist plan is necessary
headlines.description: The Army will detonate a large store of lead azide explosives at an Iowa ammunition plant at 9 a.m. local time Wednesday, officials said, insisting that the plan is the best and only option because the chemical is unstable and at risk of exploding on its own.

headlines.title: Trump to award Rudy Giuliani the Medal of Freedom, the nation’s highest civilian honor
headlines.description: President Donald Trump will award the Presidential Medal of Freedom on Tuesday to Rudy Giuliani, the controversial former mayor of New York City and ally to the president.

headlines.title: Severe Thanksgiving storms threaten millions of travelers nationwide and Macy’s Day parade
headlines.description: Heavy rain and strong winds in the Northeast on Thanksgiving Day will not only make travel difficult and dampen the holiday season kickoff, but also put the famed Macy’s parade in jeopardy.
